name: WQA — Website Quality Audit
description:
Strategic audit of the website covering technical SEO, content quality, and link foundation.
  · Run Screaming Frog crawl + Ahrefs site explorer pull
  · Classify every page (Keep / Improve / Consolidate / Remove)
  · Tag specific actions per page (Fix 404 / Rewrite / etc.)
  · Capture target pages + their backlink gaps
  · Strategist approval pass on every recommendation
Two outputs (same work stream):
  1. {slug}-wqa-data.xlsx — audit spreadsheet (4 tabs)
  2. {slug}-wqa-report.html — client-facing HTML deck (5 sections)
Auto-completes when BOTH the approvals JSON + HTML report exist on disk.

source.notes: Outputs xlsx audit spreadsheet + HTML client report.

name: Project Plan (12-month engagement)
description:
Build the structured project plan from the WQA approvals + target pages. Generates sprints + monthly deliverable schedule for the full engagement.
  · Sprints 2-6 (Technical / Local / Content / Links / Reporting)
  · Monthly batches + client check-ins
  · Per-deliverable owners, due dates, priorities
Output: {slug}-project-plan.json (exportable to ClickUp/Asana/Monday via export_project_plan.py). Auto-completed by build_project_plan.py.

source.notes: Auto-completed by build_project_plan.py on every regeneration.

name: WQA — Website Quality Audit
description: Strategic audit of the website covering technical SEO, content quality, and link foundation. Recommendations merged from the Blueprint WQA output (132 rows) plus the strategist's manual Aggregator supplemental audit (490 rows) so the plan covers all findings from both sources.

name: Project Plan (12-month engagement)
description: Structured 12-month plan built from the merged WQA + Aggregator approvals: Sprints 2-6, monthly batches, owners, due dates, priorities.

name: Fix 404 — 2 URLs
description: Technical action: Fix 404. /404 and /acess-noww return 4xx errors — restore or 301 redirect to the closest live equivalent.

name: Indexability fix — 195 URLs
description: 195 URLs (mostly /blog/*) marked non-indexable but live and structurally part of the site. Review robots/meta directives and internal linking; make indexable if it should rank, or consolidate/noindex deliberately if genuinely low-value. Full list in the WQA approvals/xlsx.

name: Noindex — 15 URLs
description: 15 category/pagination archive pages (e.g. /category/cosmetic-dentistry, /category/orthodontics + paginated variants) with no meaningful content. Add noindex to remove from crawl waste.

name: 301 redirect — 17 URLs
description: 17 URLs (category archives + legacy pages) needing 301 redirects to their correct live equivalents to preserve SEO value and avoid duplicate/thin-content weight.

name: Local SEO Audit (workbook)
description: Full Local SEO + GEO audit via /bpt-local-seo-audit — one workbook: NAP, competitive research, keyword performance, GBP change-set, aggregator/citations tracker. Basis for execution deliverables below.

name: Update GBP listings (all locations)
description: MANUAL — apply the GBP Optimization change-set per office: descriptions, categories, services, attributes, hours, true local NAP phone, localized Posts.

name: GBP Products + practice-area graphics
description: MANUAL — add GBP Products per practice area + upload branded practice-area graphics/office photos.

name: Aggregator profile optimization
description: MANUAL — claim + build out niche-aligned aggregator profiles; fix NAP mismatches; load description/services/photos/links.

name: Citation cleanup + building
description: MANUAL — work full Citations tracker (fix-first → Tier-1 free → data aggregators → build rest), NAP identical everywhere.

name: Review generation + response system
description: MANUAL — stand up review engine: NPS/review automation, compliant SMS/messaging registration, response templates, weekly monitoring.

name: Content Strategy + gap analysis
description: Sprint 4 strategic foundation. Review the full merged content queue (WQA + Aggregator), categorize by silo, identify gaps, split Refresh/Rewrite vs Create New, lock priority order for Months 3+.
